limitations: One exact macOS host development attempt; archived evidence was checked offline and current GitHub state was not queried.
No execution of producer code or archive members; no independent compiler/test rerun. Test execution is established by the exact bound raw host log and command custody records.

Local/shared SwiftPM isolation is supported by selected source enforcement, recorded config paths, mapping bytes and command chronology. Mutable config/admission/workspace-state snapshots and independent filesystem syscall tracing were not retained.

Materialized 73-file checks are recorded by the selected adapter; all 73 immutable Git blob bodies were independently rehashed in eight complete batches, but remote materialized file bytes were not themselves archived.

Custody covers 39 direct outer groups, 59 explicitly registered adapter groups and 195 inner direct children. Arbitrary installer/provider/compiler descendants, complete historic descendant inventory, provider disposal and work-directory deletion are unproven.
87396222 bytes is the largest recorded owned logical-byte sample; strict allocation peak and network wire bytes were not measured. No real output-sink failure was exercised.

No native runtime, simulator/emulator, UI/capture, physical-device, immutable published-package, D0/D8, production/store/customer or GA qualification. All existing holds remained untouched by this review.
